args.body:
Summary of websites shared in #general:

1. www.informations.com — An article on the latest job report, which brought a mix of relief and concern: unemployment edged down to 7.2%.

2. www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, known for authentic Swiss cuisine. The menu features traditional dishes such as cheese fondue, hearty rösti, and chocolate fondue for dessert. Warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia create a welcoming, rustic atmosphere, and large windows offer panoramic views of the city skyline. Friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire make each visit feel like a journey to the Swiss Alps.

Hi Dora! Thanks for sharing your website (www.dora-website.com). I took a look at it — it's a nice, straightforward personal site that clearly introduces you and makes it easy to get in touch via e-mail. A couple of suggestions if you'd like to make it more engaging: add a bit more about your interests, work, or projects, and consider including some photos or links to your other profiles so visitors get a fuller picture of who you are. Overall, it's a clean and welcoming introduction — keep it up!

Hi Eve! Thanks for sharing your blog (www.eve-blog.com). I enjoyed taking a look — it's a friendly personal blog, and I love that you mention hiking as your favorite hobby; it gives readers an immediate sense of your personality. If you'd like to grow it, you could add a few recent posts, photos or details from your hikes, and maybe some links to places you recommend. A short "About Me" section would also help new visitors learn more about you. It's a lovely start — looking forward to seeing more!
